frequencyResponse.pointsContext: Exact-model Bose Professional DM3SE Technical Data Sheet, table titled On-axis Response; copied all 25 Bose Professional EQ Voicing (SPL, dB) rows from 50 Hz to 20 kHz verbatim, with no interpolation. The TDS footnote describes response/range as on-axis half-space with Bose EQ, and separately defines sensitivity as an average from 100 Hz–10 kHz with the recommended high-pass filter. The table does not state its own drive/reference level; runtime uses these published values only as a 1 kHz-normalized shape, while the independent 86 dB (1 W/1 m) sensitivity remains the absolute-level reference.

notes: Exact-model Bose Professional DesignMax DM3SE Technical Data Sheet (©2024). It specifies 85 Hz–20 kHz (-3 dB), 75 Hz–20 kHz (-10 dB), 86 dB sensitivity (1 W/1 m; on-axis half-space, 100 Hz–10 kHz average with recommended 80 Hz high-pass protection), 30 W long-term continuous / 120 W peak under the AES transducer test (the separate extended-lifecycle test rates 25 W / 100 W), 8 Ω nominal with transformer bypass, passive 2-way crossover, 140° conical nominal coverage, 101 dB calculated maximum SPL, and a two-driver coaxial system. The technical transducer table gives the LF unit as 83 mm (3.25 in), while the same sheet's overview calls it a 3.5-inch woofer; the structured woofer-size field is therefore left N/A rather than choosing between inconsistent manufacturer figures. The response points are the sheet's Bose Professional EQ-voicing curve, not its separate raw/high-pass-only column. No resonance or voice-coil value is asserted. Source: https://assets.boseprofessional.com/m/480241d9c1fa39f4/original/tds_DesignMax_DM3SE_LTR_enUS.pdf.
